text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-4723 - p99 latency SLO breach for service=ModelServing-prod (eu-west-1). p99=1.42s (SLO=0.9s). Rate spike + KV miss rate ~18%. Page routed to @alex (oncall).
alex: Ack. I'm oncall and taking this. Pulling dashboards now. Any obvious customer-facing errors?
jordan: No 5xx spikes on the surface, but I see tail latency climbing on the ml-hotpath nodes. p95 ~ 0.6s -> 0.9s, p99 ~1.4s. Trace sampling shows more full KV misses.
alex: Good call. First quick mitigations: 1) increase serving replica count 2) enable fallback small-model variant if autoscaler lags 3) warm KV cache for hotspot keys.
sam: If we scale too fast we might overload the backing DB. Let's stagger scale and watch queue depth. I'll coordinate autoscaler params.
maria: tagging eng-sre for visibility @elaine. Also, PG for customer impact: we have ~2% of requests hitting degraded tail; some interactive product flows could see slow responses.
alex: Running quick scale: ```kubectl -n prod scale deployment model-serving-hotpath --replicas=18``` will start new pods. Doing now.
incident-bot: PD-4723 acknowledged by alex at 2024-06-08T10:07:41Z.
jordan: Nice. I'm kicking off targeted cache warm: script to prefetch top-100 keys to in-memory cache. ```/ops/warm_kv.sh --keys-file /tmp/top100.txt --region eu-west-1``` executing.
sam: Autoscaler observing new pods. Queue depth increased for 30s then normalized. Keep an eye on GPU mem churn.
alex: Observability: tail latency dropped to p99=1.05s after first wave of pods, KV miss rate down to 10%. Still above SLO but improving.
elaine: Recommend temporary routing to Dedicated fallback pool for high-priority traffic for next 15m. Can we flip a subset route to dedicated? @alex
alex: Yes. Flipping canary route to dedicated for /api/v1/chat-critical. Doing config change now. ```redwoodctl route update --route chat-critical --target dedicated-euwe-01 --weight 30%``` applied.
pagerduty-bot: Escalation: PD-4723 routed to secondary oncall (maria) at 2024-06-08T10:12:05Z due to no ack by secondary in 5m.
maria: I see the state. Thanks for the handover. I'll stay on for the next 30m to validate rollback and customer impact messaging.
alex: Current plan: monitor for 10m window. If p99 < 0.95s we start gradual rollback of extra replicas; otherwise prepare further mitigations (kv prewarm expansion, small-model fallback at 50%).
jordan: Also adding a temporary rate-limit on large-batch requests for 10m: ```nginx rate_limit zone=rl 10r/s;``` low-risk stopgap.
incident-bot: PD-4723 - service health trend link: https://dash.rew/PD-4723 (metrics + traces).
sam: Noted. No customer-reported incidents yet. Support channel informed to standby: #support-escalations.
alex: p99=0.86s now after dedicated routing and warm; KV miss ~4%. I'm going to start a controlled downscale: ```kubectl -n prod scale deployment model-serving-hotpath --replicas=14``` will avoid flapping.
maria: Thanks team. I'll file a short incident note and schedule a 1-hour debrief at +2h. For now, keeping PD-4723 open until we verify stable sub-SLO for 30m. Good work. :thumbsup:
